setup.title: Company setup checklist
setup.startHint: Add your company information to create your first buyer profile.
setup.member: Ask a workspace admin to complete the company profile. You can browse the workspace in the meantime.
setup.mature: Your first sourcing job is complete. You can update your company profile anytime.
setup.brochureHint: Drop up to 5 PDFs here, up to 50 MB each. You can switch pages while files upload in this tab.
setup.uploadRejected: Some brochures couldn't be queued. Check the files and try again.
setup.pending: We're reviewing the website in the background. You can edit your industry, products, and target markets now and save when the review is ready.
setup.failedHint: Retry the website review or enter your industry and products manually.
setup.previewFailed: We couldn't load the latest company details. Try again.
setup.sessionChanged: Your sign-in changed. Refresh the page before continuing company setup.
setup.profileNeedCompany: Add a company name and at least one main product before creating a buyer profile.
setup.profileNeedProduct: Enter at least one main product here, or update your company profile and come back.
setup.profileProductSelectionCleared: The product selection for this company was cleared. Ask an admin to review the company profile.

companies.uploadSessionChanged: Sign-in changed in another tab. Refresh this page before uploading.
companies.marketsIntroDesc: Evaluate export markets using your product profile and trade signals, then bring them straight into a buyer profile.
companies.marketsCreateBuyerProfile: Create buyer profile with target markets
companies.marketsCurrentEmpty: Not specified yet — evaluate candidates below when ready.
companies.uploadDropTitle: Drop brochures or product files here, or click to upload
companies.uploadDropHint: PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, or text up to 50 MB each (max 5 files per batch). Large files transfer in resumable segments automatically.
companies.uploadMaxBatchHint: Up to 5 files can be queued at once; extra files were skipped.
companies.largePdfAlertDesc: A 2–8 MB compressed client brochure uploads and reads much faster. You can also continue directly — we transfer it in resumable segments and read the first 15 pages first so you can confirm products sooner.
companies.assetUpdatedNotice: Document progress changed. Company documents and pending facts have been refreshed.

uploadQueue.trayAria: Background file upload and document analysis progress
uploadQueue.safeToClose: Reading in the cloud — safe to switch or close this page
uploadQueue.doNotClose: Uploading — switching pages is safe; please keep this tab open
uploadQueue.beforeUnloadPrompt: Files are still uploading. Closing now will interrupt the transfer.
uploadQueue.statusPausedMeta: {done} of {total} segments saved — resume when ready
uploadQueue.statusParsingPriorityMeta: You can browse other pages during processing
uploadQueue.statusPriorityReady: First {parsed} of {total} pages ready — review products now
uploadQueue.statusPriorityReadyProducts: {products} products extracted; reading remaining pages in background
uploadQueue.statusPriorityReadyProductsClaims: {products} products & {claims} highlights extracted; reading remaining pages
uploadQueue.statusPriorityReadyFallback: Reading remaining pages in the background
uploadQueue.statusReadyPartial: Part of this document is ready
uploadQueue.statusReadyBasic: Ready for search and fact extraction
uploadQueue.errTooLargeNext: Compress the brochure under 50 MB (2–8 MB recommended) and try again.
uploadQueue.errTextTooLargeTitle: Text file exceeds the 10 MB limit
uploadQueue.errTextTooLargeNext: Split the text file under 10 MB and try again.
uploadQueue.errUnsupportedNext: Upload PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, TXT, or Markdown files.
uploadQueue.errNetworkNext: Completed segments are preserved. Click Resume transfer once reconnected.
uploadQueue.errGenericTitle: Upload or reading did not complete
uploadQueue.errGenericNext: Click Retry, or try uploading a smaller copy of the file.
uploadQueue.errParseFailedNext: Verify the file is not encrypted or corrupted, then re-export as standard PDF.
